summary: Translate the invitation as calling the friends to eat with you
before: Approach your friends that are near you. Let them come and eat lunch with us
after: Call your friends that are near you. Let them come and eat lunch with you
rationale: The verse has qrawu, rendered “ruft” by the edition, rather than an instruction to approach the friends. It also has aʕmayxu, “with you”, rendered “mit euch”; the entry’s own imperative example contrasts aʕman, “with us”. Both errors are corrected in this translation replacement.

summary: Restore the subjunctive könnten in the German wish clause
rationale: This is the unreal wish introduced by “wenn sie doch ... zerschlüge”. The supplied edition explicitly has “und wir davon zu Mittag essen könnten”; the entry drops the t in könnten.
